condition: first real bee herding run against a non-claude agent kind hits a mid-run interactive stall (permission prompt/login) that idle-timeout mishandles
outcome: Fired live on smoke-agy-2 (2026-08-20): two stalls found. (1) agent prompt raced the agent's boot — brief landed before the banner; fix = wait for interactive_ready/idle after start before prompting. (2) agy asked Allow-creation mid-run; answered by hand via herdr agent send-keys — durable answer is an auto-approve flag in herding.agent_command per kind, documented, since idle-timeout alone just burns the timeout.
